statements.text: $1/4$ is greater than $1/12$ because fewer equal shares make each share larger.
$1/12$ is greater than $1/4$ because $12$ is greater than $4$.
$1/4$ and $1/12$ are equal because each numerator is $1$.

stem:
Chirag shares one bar of chocolate equally. He compares the unit fractions $1/4$ and $1/12$ from that whole.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: For the same whole, a larger denominator makes each equal share smaller, so 1/4 > 1/12. Treating the larger denominator as the larger share reverses the size relation. Equating the fractions because both numerators are 1 captures a surface feature.
